text.p: Pegasus Communications Corp said on Thursday that it has arranged acquisitions of ten independent DIRECTV providers collectively serving approximately 25,000 subscribers for $47.6 million in cash and $700,000 in stock.
The acquired territories comprise in excess of 300,000 television households in 17 states, Pegasus said. Approximately 150,000 of these households are not presently passed by cable, the company said.

These acquisitions, one of which has been completed, will increase Pegasus' exclusive DIRECTV territory to 1.7 million TV households serving approximately 80,000 direct broadcast satellite subscribers in 24 states.
Collectively, these service territories include approximately 9.0 million predominantly rural TV households and in excess of 560,000 DIRECTV subscribers, the company said.
